title: Simulation
description: The SimulationSpec, the one document that describes a simulation's setup (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4, ADR-006, ADR-026), and the wire shapes of /api/simulations. Physical quantities are stored as the user typed them, { value, unit }, and converted to SI only by the deck generator. A spec may be incomplete (null values, items without faces) so the setup can be saved as it is built; pre-run validation (M1.12) lists what is missing. Each message is a definition under $defs.

Quantity.description: A physical value exactly as the user entered it. unit is a symbol from packages/spec/units.json of the kind the field names; a unit of the wrong kind is refused when the spec is saved.

OptionalQuantity.description: A Quantity, or null until the user has entered it.

ItemId.description: Identifier of a material, support or load, chosen by the client and unique within the spec.

ItemName.description: The name shown in the simulation tree and the report.

FaceTags.description: Face tags from the geometry's topology.json (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3). Empty while the user has not picked any.

AnalysisType.description: linear_static: small-displacement linear elastic static analysis, one load step.

BodyAssignment.description: A body of the geometry and the material it is made of. Every body of the geometry appears exactly once.

material.description: Id of an entry in materials; null until one is assigned.

IsotropicMaterial.description: A linear elastic isotropic material. The spec holds its own copy of the values, so a run made from it never changes when a library material does.

youngsModulus.description: Young's modulus, a pressure quantity greater than zero; null until entered.

poissonsRatio.description: Poisson's ratio, dimensionless, between -1 and 0.5 exclusive; null until entered.

density.description: Mass density, a density quantity greater than zero (M2.3). Needed only by gravity and centrifugal loads; absent or null until entered.

thermalExpansion.description: Coefficient of linear thermal expansion, a thermalExpansion quantity (M2.7); zero and negative values are allowed. Needed only by a temperature change; absent or null until entered.

source.description: Where the values came from, as text: a library material's citation, or a note the user saved with a custom material (M2.9, ADR-046). Information only; the setup drops it when a value is changed, since the values then no longer match it. Absent when unknown.

MaterialReference.description: A document the material library cites.

MaterialLibrary.description: packages/spec/library/materials.json, the generic library materials (M2.9, ADR-046). Each material holds its values exactly as its source prints them, and its source names the table they come from.

MaterialsResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/materials: the library's materials in library order, and the signed-in user's own materials by name (M2.9, ADR-046). A material is copied into a simulation with a new id; later changes to either side do not reach the other.

SaveMaterialRequest.description: Body of POST /api/materials: a material to keep among the user's own materials, usable in every simulation of theirs. Its id is ignored and a new one given. Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio must be entered; its name must not be one of theirs already.

MaterialResponse.description: Answer to POST /api/materials (HTTP 201): the saved material with its new id.

FixedSupport.description: All displacement components of the faces' nodes held at zero.

DisplacementComponent.description: One global component of a prescribed displacement: a length quantity (zero holds it, any other value moves the faces by that much), "free" when the component is not prescribed, or null until the user has chosen.

PrescribedDisplacement.description: The faces' nodes moved by a given displacement in the global x, y and z directions; a free component is left to the solution. At least one component must have a value before a run.

FrictionlessSupport.description: Each face held against moving along its own normal and free to slide in its plane, in both directions (it does not lift off). The support for symmetry planes. Flat faces only (DECISIONS.md, gate scope).

ElasticSupport.description: The faces rest on an elastic foundation (M2.6): at every point the foundation pushes back along the face's normal with a pressure equal to the stiffness times the displacement along the normal, in both directions (it does not lift off). It does not resist sliding along the faces. Written as grounded springs along the normal at each node, each with the stiffness times the node's share of the face area.

stiffness.description: Foundation stiffness, the pressure per unit of normal displacement, a foundationStiffness quantity greater than zero.

PressureLoad.description: A uniform pressure normal to each face. A positive magnitude pushes on the face towards the body (along the inward normal), as a fluid does; a negative one pulls (suction).

magnitude.description: A pressure quantity; null until entered.

ForceLoad.description: A total force in the global x, y and z directions spread over the faces in proportion to area, as a uniform traction (consistent nodal loads in the deck). Each component is a force quantity, null until entered.

GravityLoad.description: The acceleration of gravity in the global x, y and z directions, acting on every body through its material's density: the weight points along it (z = -1 g for gravity downwards along z). Each component is an acceleration quantity, null until entered. Several gravity loads add up.

TemperatureLoad.description: A uniform temperature change of every body from the stress-free state (M2.7): each material expands by its thermal expansion coefficient times the change, and the supports resist it. change is a temperatureDifference quantity, null until entered; a fall is negative. One per setup.

AxisPoint.description: A point in global coordinates; each coordinate a length quantity, null until entered.

AxisDirection.description: A direction in global axes, dimensionless and of any length other than zero; each component null until entered.

CentrifugalLoad.description: Every body spinning steadily about an axis: a body force density times angular velocity squared times the distance from the axis, pointing away from it. The sense of rotation does not matter. One per setup.

angularVelocity.description: An angular velocity quantity; null until entered.

axisPoint.description: A point on the axis of rotation.

axisDirection.description: The direction of the axis of rotation.

Components.description: Components along the global x, y and z axes; each a quantity, null until entered.

RemoteLoad.description: A force and a moment acting at a reference point, carried to the faces as the statically equivalent linear traction (a deformable, distributing connection; consistent nodal loads in the deck). The force acting at the point also turns the faces about it. Force components are force quantities, moment components moment quantities, in global axes and right-handed; each null until entered.

point.description: The reference point the force and moment act at.

force.description: The force at the reference point.

moment.description: The moment at the reference point.

HydrostaticLoad.description: The pressure of a still fluid on the faces: p = density × (gravity · (x − s)) at a point x at or below the free surface through s, zero above it. The fluid is on the outside of each face, so the pressure pushes on the face towards the body. Consistent nodal loads in the deck. Each value null until entered.

fluidDensity.description: The fluid's density, a density quantity.

gravity.description: The acceleration of gravity acting on the fluid, acceleration quantities in global axes (z = -1 g for gravity downwards along z). Depth is measured along it; it is not applied to the bodies (add a gravity load for their weight).

freeSurface.description: A point on the fluid's free surface, the plane normal to gravity where the pressure is zero.

LocalMeshScope.description: What a local mesh size applies to: faces, edges or bodies of the geometry, by their topology.json tags.

LocalMeshSize.description: A smaller element size on some faces, edges or bodies (M2.8, ADR-045). The mesh grows from it to the global size away from them.

tags.description: Face, edge or body tags, as scope says; empty until picked.

size.description: Element size on them, a length quantity greater than zero and no larger than the global size; null until entered.
Global element size, a length quantity greater than zero; null until entered.

order.description: Element order (M2.8). Absent in specs saved before M2.8, which means 2.

local.description: Local mesh sizes (M2.8). Absent in specs saved before M2.8, which means none.

SimulationSpec.description: Version 1: one linear static analysis of the bodies of one geometry, isotropic materials, fixed supports, prescribed displacements and frictionless supports (M2.2), elastic supports (M2.6), pressures, forces, gravity and a centrifugal load (M2.3), a uniform temperature change (M2.7), and the mesh settings: a global size, the element order and local sizes (M2.8). Item types joining an array do not change version (ADR-026 item 1); version changes whenever the meaning or shape of existing data does; older stored specs are upgraded by code, never reinterpreted.

geometryId.description: The geometry whose face and body tags the spec uses.

SimulationView.description: A simulation as its owner sees it.

CreateSimulationRequest.description: Body of POST /api/simulations. The geometry must be ready (its unit confirmed); from then on its unit is locked. Without spec the simulation starts empty, with every body of the geometry listed and no material assigned.

SimulationResponse.description: Answer to POST /api/simulations (HTTP 201), GET /api/simulations/{id} and PUT /api/simulations/{id}/spec.

SimulationListResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/simulations[?geometryId=]: the signed-in user's simulations, newest first.

ElementOrder.description: 1: four-node tetrahedra (CalculiX C3D4). 2: ten-node tetrahedra with curved edges on curved faces (C3D10), the default (ADR-028, ADR-045).

MeshParams.description: Parameters of a mesh job (ADR-028). The worker re-imports the geometry's STEP file with scaling, checks it against topology.json, and meshes it with tetrahedra no larger than size.

geometryId.description: The geometry whose model.step and topology.json the job reads.

scaling.description: Geometry.OCCScaling of the geometry's topology.json; the re-import must use the same.

size.description: Global element size as the user entered it (a length quantity); the worker converts it to metres.

local.description: Local sizes (M2.8), each complete: tags picked and a size entered.

tags.description: Never empty when sent by the API.

MeshQuality.description: Quality summary of a mesh (M2.8, ADR-045). shape is Gmsh's gamma, the inscribed to circumscribed sphere radius ratio scaled so a regular tetrahedron is 1 and a flat one 0. jacobianMin is the smallest scaled Jacobian of any element, 1 for an undistorted one; curved second-order elements fall below 1.

shapeHistogram.description: Number of elements with shape in [0, 0.1), [0.1, 0.2), ... [0.9, 1].

MeshResult.description: Result summary of a succeeded mesh job.

surfaceTriangles.description: Triangles in the mesh display file.

MeshStatus.description: meshing: the mesh job is queued or running. ready: the mesh and its display file exist. failed: problem says why.

MeshView.description: A mesh as its owner sees it.

size.description: The global size the mesh was made with, as entered.

local.description: The local sizes the mesh was made with, as entered (M2.8).

problem.description: Why meshing failed, in plain language.

quality.description: Null until the mesh is ready, and for meshes made before M2.8.

MeshResponse.description: Answer to POST /api/simulations/{id}/mesh (HTTP 201 for a new mesh, 200 when a mesh with the same settings hash is reused, ADR-047) and GET /api/meshes/{id}.

reused.description: Present on POST /api/simulations/{id}/mesh: true when an existing mesh of the same geometry, unit and mesh settings was reused, so no mesh job was queued or charged.

SimulationMeshResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/simulations/{id}/mesh: the simulation's latest mesh, or null before the first one is requested.

SolveParams.description: Parameters of a solve job (ADR-030): the run's frozen spec and the mesh it is solved on. The worker writes the deck from these two alone.

meshId.description: The mesh whose mesh.bin the job reads.

NodeValue.description: A nodal result value and where it occurs. SI units; position in metres.

node.description: Index of the node in mesh.bin, from 0.

SupportReaction.description: Total reaction force of one support, in newtons: CalculiX's total for the support's node set when every support is fixed, otherwise the sum over its nodes of the force along the directions it holds, shared with other supports at nodes they also hold (ADR-039).

SolveResult.description: Result summary of a succeeded solve job (ADR-030). Displacement in metres, stress in pascals, forces in newtons.

nodes.description: Nodes with results; every node of the mesh.

vonMises.description: Smallest and largest von Mises stress of CalculiX's nodal stresses.

reactions.description: One entry per support, in spec order.

RunStatus.description: solving while the solve job is queued or running; succeeded or failed once it ends.

RunSoftware.description: Versions that produced a run (ADR-032): gmsh and occt made its mesh; clearfea, deckFormat and calculix are the worker's that solved it. Null when not known, for example before the worker has reported or for runs made before M1.10.

RunMesh.description: The mesh a run was solved on, as it was made. Meshes do not change once ready.

RunFileName.description: A file a solve job stores for its run. deck.inp and solver.log can be viewed and downloaded through GET /api/runs/{id}/files/{name}.

RunMachine.description: The machine size a run was billed on and its rate, fixed when the run started (ADR-033). Money is in whole micro-credits: 1,000,000 is one credit.

ratePerHour.description: Micro-credits per hour of billable time.

RunCost.description: What a finished run's solve job cost (ADR-033). billedSeconds is the measured time rounded up to whole seconds; amount is billedSeconds times the hourly rate over 3600, in micro-credits rounded to the nearest one. charged is false when the job failed through a fault in ClearFEA, which the user does not pay for; amount is then 0.

SizeEstimate.description: What a run is estimated to cost on one machine size (M2.12, ADR-049). Money is in whole micro-credits: 1,000,000 is one credit.

ratePerHour.description: Micro-credits per hour of billable time.

cost.description: The estimated seconds, billed at this size's rate.

fits.description: Whether the size's usable memory holds the estimated peak memory with the estimator's margin.

RunEstimate.description: Memory, time and cost estimated for solving a simulation on its mesh, from the estimator's fitted coefficients (packages/spec/estimator.json, ADR-049), and the machine size recommended: the smallest that fits, or null when none does.

estimator.description: Version of estimator.json that made the estimate.

nodes.description: The mesh's node count the estimate is made from.

memoryBytes.description: Estimated peak memory of the solver.

seconds.description: Estimated billable time of the solve job, whole seconds.

extrapolated.description: True when the mesh is larger than any the estimator was fitted on, so the estimate is less certain.

EstimateResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/simulations/{id}/estimate: the estimate for the simulation's current ready mesh.

CreateRunRequest.description: Body of POST /api/simulations/{id}/runs, which may also be sent empty. machineSize names the machine size to run on; without it the run takes the recommended size (the largest when none fits).

RunView.description: A run as its owner sees it, with the record frozen when it started (ADR-030, ADR-032, ADR-033).

spec.description: The setup as it was saved when the run started.

files.description: The files stored for the run, known once it has finished; empty while it solves.

machine.description: Null for runs made before M1.11, which were not metered.

estimate.description: The estimate made when the run started (ADR-049); null for runs made before M2.12.

cost.description: Known once the run has finished; null while it solves and for runs that were not metered.

stage.description: What the solve job is doing: queued, then the worker's stage.

problem.description: Why the run failed, in plain language.

RunListResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/simulations/{id}/runs: the simulation's runs, newest first.

RunLogResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/runs/{id}/log?after={n}: the solver log written after chunk n, and the n to ask with next time.
